intro: Bloodied Insignias are tragic remnants of the fallen defenders of Lordaeron, scattered among the kingdom's blighted ruins. Bearing the old crests of the Alliance, these battered badges represent soldiers whose families fled south to Stormwind during the Third War.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, friend. What is it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.
Your duty to Stormwind is commended, friend. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
